verdict.rationale: A scope-approval gate before work begins is a fair question for a feedback-to-tasks product like Canny, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows updating idea statuses and sending feedback to Jira, Linear, GitHub, ClickUp, or Asana with status sync. Those are adjacent workflow and integration features, not a documented review-and-approve step for task scope before work starts.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can review and approve the scope of a task before any work begins on it
